description: Edit-to-pixels budgets for the Hammer editor's viewports on the RFC 0016 render core (RFC 0016 decision 'threading'; RFC 0002 R17). A sample is the time from issuing one edit on the host sequence (a move of one solid through the command layer) to all four views' new frames arriving back on the host sequence from the render sequence: the snapshot update, the immutable scene copy, staging, recording, GPU execution, readback and the replies. Set before measurement from the RFC 0016 decision's 16 ms for sp_a2_trust_fling across four views. Measured by tools/quality/hammer_viewport_budget.py with hammer_gtk --viewport-budget. Limits hold on a quiet host; a heavily loaded one (load average near 28) measured p95 18.4 ms on the trust_fling row.

rows.note: The frames the window shows: each view renders into an exported image (clause D18) that reaches the host as a dmabuf lease instead of read-back pixels; the host returns the lease at once. Same limits as the read-back row.
